definitions.explanation: The method of drying food, cloth, or other items by exposing them to direct sunlight. A traditional preservation and processing technique widely used in Japanese food culture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{天日干|てんぴぼ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{天日干|てんぴぼ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{干物|ひもの}→干物：12423_himono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧うまみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: Sun-dried fish has a strong umami flavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{天日干|てんぴぼ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦ふかふか→ふかふか：10475_fukafuka⟧になって{気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: When you dry a futon in the sun, it becomes fluffy and feels wonderful.

notes:
A traditional technique of drying things in direct sunlight. In Japanese food culture, sun-drying concentrates flavors and is seen as superior to machine drying. The word {天日|てんぴ} means sunlight used for drying.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天日干|てんぴぼ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sun-dry
- {天日干|てんぴぼ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧: sun-dried salt (natural sea salt)
- {天日干|てんぴぼ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{干物|ひもの}→干物：12423_himono⟧: sun-dried fish
- {天日干|てんぴぼ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧: sun-dried rice

FOOD CULTURE:
{天日干|てんぴぼ}し products are considered premium. {天日干|てんぴぼ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (sun-dried salt) and {天日干|てんぴぼ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{干物|ひもの}→干物：12423_himono⟧ (sun-dried fish) are marketed as natural and superior to industrially processed alternatives.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{干物|ひもの}→干物：12423_himono⟧: dried fish — often made by sun-drying
- {天日|てんぴ}: sunlight (for drying purposes)
- ⟦{陰干|かげぼ}し→陰干し：26260_kageboshi⟧: drying in the shade — used for delicate items like silk
